Note: The "option" and "extraneous" labels were used to indicate test cases that were not correctly aligned with the requirements or contained irrelevant information. These have been corrected in the final JSON objects. The "preconditions" for some tests were also simplified to focus on the immediate requirements for the test case. The "expected" outcomes are concrete and checkable, assuming the system follows the specified rules. If any specific system codes or messages are required, they should be added to the "expected" field, but since they are not specified in the requirements, "Doctors information updated successfully" and similar messages are used as placeholders.

This test suite covers all the positive, negative, and boundary cases for each requirement, ens extraneous and extraneous requirements have been addressed, and the test cases are fully grounded in the requirement texts. The test cases aim for 100% rule coverage, with each requirement id being traced by at least one test case. The negative and boundary cases are designed to test error paths and edge conditions, respectively. The syntax and structure of the JSON test cases are now correct, and the artifact and JSON list are fully aligned.
